author: ReTrace
description: PCAP analysis via the external tshark binary.

tools.name: tshark_conversations
tools.capability: TCP conversations (endpoints, packets, bytes) in a capture file.

tools.name: tshark_dns
tools.capability: DNS queries in a capture file.

tools.name: tshark_http
tools.capability: HTTP requests in a capture: destination IP, host, method, URI, user-agent.

tools.name: tshark_protocols
tools.capability: Protocol hierarchy of a capture file (which protocols and volumes are present).
